evals.prompt: Audit this long Codex session for steering drift. I care about where my instructions stopped affecting the agent's behavior and what I can learn for future prompting.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed audit plan and artifact stack that uses mechanical extraction only as a locator, writes contrastive audit cards, separates evidence from inference, and avoids claiming an automatic score.

evals.prompt: Find cases where ABD was acknowledged but not operationalized. I want to understand whether the agent kept lane state live or just repeated the words back.
evals.expected_output: A focused dispatch/object-continuity audit with cards naming worker lanes, authority, state, evidence, owner gates, and counterexamples.

evals.prompt: Compare high-output windows against actual steering burden. I remember some windows where the agent was flying, but I do not know how to identify them.
evals.expected_output: A contrastive analysis separating clean/mostly-clean flying from high-output/high-friction and live-evidence firefighting, with candidate windows, controls, and caveats.
